Name: Bentley's Fast Food
Author: Bentley Playz
Description: Adds Cheeseburger, French Fries, Coke, Windex, the Farmhand Snack Pack and Chicken Nuggets, breakfast and seasonal menus, Bentley's Fast Food restaurant on the Bus Stop (walk-in interior, ordering counter menu, dessert corner, arcade), the Restaurant Kiosk and Bentley the restaurant-owner NPC. One mod: this Content part and the Code part (a single DLL) live in the same folder.
